tasks.subject: Task 2: src/markdown.js — HTML → lightweight markdown
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Convert a rendered GitHub comment body (.markdown-body element) back to lightweight markdown (inline code, links, bold/italic, code blocks, lists, blockquotes).

**Files:**
- Create: src/markdown.js
- Test: tests/markdown.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- code → backticks; links → [text](href); @mentions and text-equals-href links stay plain
- strong/b → **…**, em/i → *…*, br → newline
- pre → fenced block; ul/ol → -/1. lines; paragraphs separated by one blank line
- whitespace in text nodes collapsed

**Verify:** npm test

tasks.subject: Task 4: src/diff-hunk.js — diff window extraction
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Serialize the diff window around a commented line range — up to 3 rendered context lines above the start line through the end line — with a synthesized @@ header.

**Files:**
- Create: src/diff-hunk.js
- Test: tests/diff-hunk.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- extractHunk(file, 'R', 444, 446) on fixture → window starting '@@ -0,0 +441,6 @@' with 6 + lines
- Lines keep +/-/space markers and exact text (textContent — code split across syntax spans)
- null when file table or commented rows absent
- No line rendered twice for context rows with two number cells

**Verify:** npm test

Full code in plan Task 4. Fixture is ground truth — if exact counts fail, fix implementation, not window semantics.

tasks.subject: Task 6: src/comment-menu.js — injection + wiring + manifest

- Item appears exactly once per menu open
- Existing line-review behavior unchanged
- All failure paths toast instead of throwing into GitHub's React tree

**Verify:** npm test && npm run build, then manual steps in plan Task 6 Step 5 (reload extension, real PR kebab → item → clipboard matches template, reply kebab, regression checks)
